name: After recital AB
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: ABa. whereas the new law on public procurement, which was adopted by the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine on 27 May 2026 and came into force on 24 June 2026, is widely considered to be a genuine reform, aligned with EU legislation and establishing transparency and anti-corruption safeguards for large tenders; whereas the adoption of this legislation unlocked USD 3.4 billion in direct budget support for Ukraine from the World Bank;
